Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649972. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and filter by assay_id. Filter for exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Do not deduplicate; return every qualifying activity row. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
